description: Diagnoses connectivity to the TIA Openness `serve` API and whether the server is ACTIVATED. Tests GET /health (reachability) and GET /readiness (license activation). Ideal for the MCP-on-Mac-pointing-at-a-`serve`-on-a-Windows-VM scenario. Read-only. Returns { base, reachable, activated, latencyMs, hint }.
name: tia_ping
title: TIA — connection diagnostics
